groups.defect: Hardcoded 10MB limits in client validation, upload error messages, and API downloads conflict with configurable upload limits, blocking permitted uploads, admitting oversized attachments, and displaying incorrect limits.
groups.rationale: These reports overlap through explicit complaints about the client cap, API download cap, and inaccurate error messages. The repeated hardcoding requires edits at multiple locations.

groups.defect: The five-pass 80% downsize loop can leave images above the configured limit and ignores downsize failures, undermining the promised automatic reduction.
groups.rationale: All three report the insufficient fixed iteration budget in the same loop. Two additionally report ignored conversion failures, which the merged comment must preserve.

groups.defect: The second downsize definition overrides the width/height signature, leaving the earlier definition dead and breaking existing positional callers.
groups.rationale: Every report identifies the same method replacement and incompatible calling contract. The four-argument type errors and five-argument ResizeEmoji failures are manifestations of that single defect.
